name: Cyber Safety Cop
_forbidden_text_note: Co-brand partner names are ONLY allowed on archetype CSC_I co-branded posts. For non-co-branded posts, OCR finding partner names = fail.

typography.display: Bold sans-serif HEAVY weight, often condensed (Montserrat / Poppins / Bebas Neue style)
typography.body: Regular sans-serif, navy or white, generous line height
typography.rule: NO italic serif emphasis (that's the IEC pattern, not CSC). Headlines command via weight and case, not italic.

archetypes.CSC_A_numbered_listicle_yellow: Sunny yellow #FFDE59 full background. Header pill at top. 3 numbered rows with FILLED solid blue circles + white numerals. Most-used CSC archetype.
archetypes.CSC_B_app_review: Split layout. Phone on left, vertical text stack right with 'APP REVIEW' badge.
archetypes.CSC_C_command_overlay_photo: Full-bleed photo of child/teen with phone. Top-left bold sans ALL CAPS three-word command in white or yellow.
archetypes.CSC_D_big_number_hero: Yellow background. Huge electric blue numeral + topic headline. Photo of parent + child bottom half with blue swoosh.
archetypes.CSC_E_webinar_promo_card: Cream/white. Cursive script overhead text + bold sans below. Laptop mockup with webinar landing.
archetypes.CSC_F_membership_promo: Bright background with playful active kid photo. Bold mixed-case header. Value-stack list of 3-4 items.
archetypes.CSC_G_image_overlay_callout: Full-bleed photo + semi-transparent overlay covering lower 60%. CSC logo top-center on photo.
archetypes.CSC_H_membership_launch_announcement: Vibrant photo (kid in costume, megaphone). Red/yellow ribbon banner with announcement headline. Decorative starburst accents.
archetypes.CSC_I_brand_deal_comparison: Co-branded split-card. Two color-blocked panels side-by-side (CSC + partner colors). ONLY archetype where Bright Canary coral or other partner colors appear.

hard_rules: FILLED solid blue circles with white numerals (NOT hollow ring — that's OMG's pattern).
Sunny yellow #FFDE59 is the saturated brand yellow — NEVER muted/pastel yellow.
Bright Canary pink/coral palette appears ONLY on archetype CSC_I co-branded posts. Never mix into standard CSC posts.
Calm-not-alarmist tone — no fear-mongering, no shocked-mom cliché, no horror-movie palette, no predator panic imagery.
Logo (circular people icon) or CYBERSAFETYCOP.COM url lockup must be visible on every post.
When AI rendering for CSC, leave a clean solid-color top 12% zone for logo composite (no clean-band painting after the fact — color match will not be exact).
Logo composite via overlay_logo.py with --position top-center --max-logo-width 0.40. Do NOT use --clean-band on existing rendered posts (causes visible color seam).
NO italic serif emphasis in headlines (that's IEC pattern). CSC headlines command via weight and case.
